## Key configuration

name: chrysa-github-actions
requires-python: >=3.12
version: 0.0.0

## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
.claude/hooks/format.py
.claude/hooks/read_guard.py
notion_sync/__init__.py — Notion sync entrypoints used by the notion-* composite actions.
notion_sync/branch_sync.py — Sync the pushed branch to the shared Notion "Branch Activity" database.
notion_sync/logging_setup.py — Logging wired to the GitHub Actions log stream.
notion_sync/notion_api.py — Minimal stdlib-only Notion + GitHub REST helpers shared by the sync entrypoints.
notion_sync/roadmap_sync.py — Sync an issue/PR event to the project's Notion roadmap table row.
scripts/gen_context_files.py — Generate the standardised per-repo context files from the repo's own content.
scripts/quality_gate.py
shortcut_sync/__init__.py — Daily Shortcut sync: GitHub issues mirrored into Shortcut, epic and objective states kept in step.
shortcut_sync/__main__.py — ``python3 -m shortcut_sync`` — run the daily Shortcut sync.
shortcut_sync/closed_issue_resolver.py — Step 1 — a story created by the sync moves to done once its GitHub issue is closed.
shortcut_sync/entrypoint.py — Entrypoint: read the environment, run the job, log counts, set the exit code.
shortcut_sync/epic_progress_plan.py — The state move one epic needs so it follows its stories (owner rule sc-5963, reduced by sc-6014).
shortcut_sync/epic_progress_sync.py — Step 3 — epic states follow the stories, then objectives follow the epics (sc-5963, sc-6014).
shortcut_sync/epic_timeline.py — What the stories of one epic say: whether work has started, and whether it all ended.
shortcut_sync/epic_workflow_states.py — Epic states resolved from ``GET /api/v3/epic-workflow`` — no state id is hardcoded.
shortcut_sync/errors.py — Typed errors raised by the Shortcut sync.
shortcut_sync/github_client.py — GitHub REST API — issues and issue comments of the mapped repositories.
shortcut_sync/http_client.py — Stdlib JSON-over-HTTPS client with request pacing and bounded retries.
shortcut_sync/issue_importer.py — Step 2 — open GitHub issues without a Shortcut link become stories in the mapped epic.
shortcut_sync/issue_key.py — Identity of a GitHub issue, normalised so URLs and story markers compare equal.
shortcut_sync/objective_progress_sync.py — Objectives start with their first started epic; they are never set to done (sc-5963).
shortcut_sync/payloads.py — Typed shapes of the API payloads the sync reads (only the fields it uses).
shortcut_sync/progress_writer.py — The only place that writes epics and objectives: dry-run aware, within the update cap.
shortcut_sync/references.py — Pure helpers: Shortcut references, story typing, linked issues, issue comments.
shortcut_sync/repo_mapping.py — Repository ↔ epic mapping, keyed by the epic ``external_id`` ``<owner>/<repo>``.
shortcut_sync/repo_snapshot.py — What the run read for one reachable repository.
shortcut_sync/shortcut_client.py — Shortcut REST API v3 — only the calls the sync needs.
shortcut_sync/story_draft.py — A story about to be created. Deliberately has no label field (owner rule: no labels).
shortcut_sync/story_writer.py — The only place that writes stories: creation and move-to-done, dry-run aware.
shortcut_sync/sync_config.py — Job configuration read from the environment.
shortcut_sync/sync_context.py — Dependencies shared by every sync step: configuration, API clients, report.
shortcut_sync/sync_counter.py — Names of the counters the job reports. Logs carry only these counts and numeric ids.
shortcut_sync/sync_job.py — One run: read Shortcut and GitHub, close and import repo by repo, then sync epic progress.
shortcut_sync/sync_report.py — Run report: counters, the story-creation and epic/objective-update budgets, the action log.
shortcut_sync/workflow_states.py — Workflow states resolved from ``GET /api/v3/workflows`` — no state id is hardcoded.
tests/conftest.py — Shared fixtures. ``fake_http`` replaces the network for the shortcut_sync tests.
tests/test_actions_yaml.py — Every composite action definition in this repo must be valid and runnable.
